record.context_brief: constructing Einstein metrics of negative scalar curvature
record.original_question: Find a method for constructing Einstein metrics with negative scalar curvature.

evidence.quote: Question 3.8. Find a way to construct Einstein metrics with negative scalar curvatures.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Riemannian manifold $(M^n, g)$ of dimension $n \geq 2$ is called Einstein if its Ricci curvature tensor is a constant multiple of the metric, i.e. $\mathrm{Ric}_g = \lambda\, g$ for some constant $\lambda \in \mathbb{R}$. Equivalently, the trace-free Ricci tensor vanishes; the constant $\lambda$ has the same sign as the scalar curvature $S_g = n\lambda$.

Provide a general construction method that produces Einstein metrics of negative scalar curvature. More precisely, describe a procedure that, given suitable topological or geometric input data (for example, a smooth manifold, possibly with additional structure such as a complex, conformal, or fibered structure), outputs a Riemannian metric $g$ on the underlying manifold satisfying $\mathrm{Ric}_g = \lambda g$ with $\lambda < 0$, in a way that is not restricted to locally homogeneous (in particular, locally symmetric) examples and that goes beyond the Aubin–Yau existence theorem for Kähler–Einstein metrics with negative first Chern class.
artifact.status_search_result: General constructions of negative-scalar-curvature Einstein metrics exist in special settings: the Aubin–Yau theorem produces Kähler–Einstein metrics with negative Ricci curvature whenever the canonical bundle is ample, and more recent work (e.g. Fine–Premoselli on branched covers of real hyperbolic 4-manifolds, and constructions near log-canonical singularities) provides further families. However, a general, non-locally-symmetric construction method in arbitrary dimensions remains an active research problem rather than a fully resolved one.

status_evidence.title: Kähler–Einstein metric - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: When the first Chern class is negative, there is always a Kähler–Einstein metric, as Aubin and Yau proved independently.
status_evidence.claim: Aubin–Yau gives a construction in the Kähler case with negative first Chern class.

status_evidence.title: Kähler–Einstein metrics of negative curvature
status_evidence.snippet: First examples of negatively curved Einstein metrics not locally symmetric due to Fine and Premoselli via branched covers of real hyperbolic four-manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: New constructions of negatively curved Einstein metrics continue to appear.

status_evidence.title: On the construction of a complete Kähler-Einstein metric with negative scalar curvature near an isolated log-canonical singularity
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of complete Kähler–Einstein metrics with negative scalar curvature near isolated log canonical singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Construction methods exist in singular Kähler settings.
